task: Parse an AWS CloudFormation template and extract all resource logical IDs that have a type of 'AWS::S3::Bucket'
solution_criteria: Function should accept a CloudFormation template dictionary as input and return a list of logical IDs for S3 buckets. Should handle templates with no S3 buckets gracefully.

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that processes S3 events, with environment variables for a DynamoDB table name and SNS topic ARN
solution_criteria: JSON object should include handler, runtime, timeout, memory, environment variables section with DynamoDB_TABLE and SNS_TOPIC_ARN keys, and a basic S3 event source mapping structure.

task: Write a regex pattern that validates AWS IAM role ARN format (arn:aws:iam::account-id:role/role-name)
solution_criteria: Pattern should match valid IAM role ARNs with proper account ID (12 digits) and role name containing alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and forward slashes. Should reject malformed ARNs.
